2026-11-17.intro: Happy National Take a Hike Day! Last year, millions of people hit the trails in America's busiest national parks.
2026-11-17.prompt: Click the states with one of the 10 most-visited national parks in 2025 (National Park Service).

2026-11-18.intro: It's Mickey Mouse's birthday! Mickey first appeared in Steamboat Willie on this day in 1928.
2026-11-18.prompt: Click the states where Disney built, or once planned, a theme park (Disney).

2026-11-19.intro: On this day in 1863, Abraham Lincoln gave the Gettysburg Address at the new national cemetery on the battlefield.
2026-11-19.prompt: Click the states whose Confederate troops fought at Gettysburg (National Park Service).

2026-11-22.intro: On this day in 1963, President John F. Kennedy was assassinated in Dallas. In 1960, he became the first Catholic president.
2026-11-22.prompt: Click the 6 states, districts or territories with the highest share of Catholics (WorldAtlas).

2026-11-26.intro: Happy Thanksgiving! Today's question is about the bird on the table.
2026-11-26.prompt: Click the 7 states that raise the most turkeys (USDA).

2026-12-21.intro: Happy first day of winter! Today is the shortest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere.
2026-12-21.prompt: Click the states that have hit -60°F or colder (NOAA).

2026-12-25.intro: Merry Christmas! Most real Christmas trees in America come from just a handful of states.
2026-12-25.prompt: Click the top 7 states for Christmas trees (USDA Census of Agriculture, 2022).

2027-01-01.intro: Happy New Year! New Year's Day is one of the biggest days of the year for college football, starting with the Rose Bowl.
2027-01-01.prompt: Click the states that host a New Year's Six bowl game (College Football Playoff, 2026).

2027-02-14.prompt: Click the states whose NFL teams have won 4 or more Super Bowls, by home stadium (NFL, 2026).

2027-02-15.prompt: Click the states west of the Mississippi where a president was born (White House).

2027-04-15.intro: It's Tax Day! Some states give their residents a break.
2027-04-15.prompt: Click the states with no state income tax on wages (Tax Foundation, 2026).

2027-04-22.intro: Happy Earth Day! Today's question celebrates America's national parks.
2027-04-22.prompt: Click the states with exactly 2 national parks (National Park Service, 2026).

2027-05-05.intro: Happy Cinco de Mayo! In 1848, Mexico gave up a huge stretch of land to the United States.

2027-05-31.intro: Memorial Day: remembering the Americans who died serving in the military.

2027-07-04.intro: Happy 4th of July! The 13 colonies declared independence on this day in 1776.

2027-07-20.intro: On this day in 1969, Apollo 11 landed on the Moon.
